tasks.label: Python: Set up virtual environment
tasks.command: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r requirements-test.txt

tasks.label: HA: Start persistent server
tasks.command: source .venv/bin/activate && TEST_COMPONENTS_PATH=$(python scripts/prepare_ha_test_components.py) && HA_VERSION=$(awk 'NF && $1 !~ /^#/ { print; exit }' tests/HA_VERSION) && HA_VERSION=$HA_VERSION HA_CONFIG_PATH=tests/ha-config HA_CUSTOM_COMPONENTS_PATH=$TEST_COMPONENTS_PATH HA_SETUP_INTEGRATION=approved_scripts python -m ha_testcontainer.ha_server

tasks.label: pytest: All security tests
tasks.command: source .venv/bin/activate && if [ -f .ha_env ]; then source .ha_env; fi && pytest tests/

tasks.label: pytest: Run individual security test
tasks.command: source .venv/bin/activate && if [ -f .ha_env ]; then source .ha_env; fi && pytest tests/test_runtime_security.py -k '${input:testExpression}'

inputs.description: pytest -k expression, e.g. stale or executes_snapshot
